name: Ring of Confrontation
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 1st; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a diplomat’s ring and functions as such. However, initial attitudes towards the wearer are one step lower than they would normally be. Additionally, individuals who would have normally had the attitude of hostile will attack immediately and make the wearer the primary target of their attacks. An attacker will not put himself in harm’s way, such as passing through a threatened space, to do so.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it, rendering it non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items diplomat’s ring

Identification DC 26
False Identification DC 16
